rule: game-lines desk probability + passing desk verdict + DraftKings price, pre-game only
note: No pre-game alerts: an alert needs a game-lines-desk probability whose verdict passed (not NO EDGE / UNPROVEN) and a DraftKings price. NBA: 9 desk verdict NO EDGE; NHL: 3 desk verdict NO EDGE; WNBA: 1 not pre-game; MLS: 15 no validated model probability (not from the game-lines desk); EPL: 1 started or no start time; UCL: 9 not pre-game; NFL: 14 desk verdict UNPROVEN; NCAAF: 16 no validated model probability (not from the game-lines desk); NCAAB: 9 no validated model probability (not from the game-lines desk); CWS: 1 not pre-game
